chapter_outcomes: Importance of marketing to travel and tourism organisations: increased sales/usage/profitability/market share/customer base, competitive advantage, positive image and reputation for sustainable practices, customer satisfaction/brand loyalty/repeat business
Factors affecting marketing: target market, appropriate timing, consideration of costs, use of brand image, reputation (e.g. from industry awards), monitoring methods
Marketing mix - Product: products and services (including sustainable products and services), product life cycle

Marketing mix - Promotion: marketing campaigns, web-based/social media/blogs/podcasts, destination brand, direct marketing, TV/radio/newspaper advertising, sales promotions, public relations, e-brochures/leaflets, trade promotions
Marketing mix - Price: market penetration, market skimming, discount pricing, variable pricing, loss leader pricing, promotional pricing, premium pricing, price bundling

Marketing mix - Place: distribution channels (e.g. direct selling, wholesalers, retailers, online), physical location (e.g. cost, character and features of the area, adjacent facilities, availability of suitable premises, availability of staff, access and transport links)

Market research and analysis - Types of market research: primary (e.g. questionnaires, surveys, interviews, focus groups), secondary (e.g. government reports, NTO statistics), qualitative/quantitative research methods
Market research and analysis - Market analysis tools: SWOT, PESTLE
Market research and analysis - Reasons for market research: understanding position in the market, identifying customer needs and wants, competitor analysis, creating marketing plans

Market segmentation and targeting - Different market segments: geographic (e.g. locality, area or region, domestic tourists and inbound visitors), demographic (e.g. age, gender, ethnicity, levels of disposable income), psychographic/lifestyle (e.g. socio-economic factors, interests, morals/values and attitudes)

Market segmentation and targeting - Development of product/service mix to target different market segments: products/services and facilities, the relationship with market segments (type of customer, quality/economy/value for money), accessibility, sustainability
